# UI Vault — full catalog

> 3157 entries from 33 sources. Generated by `npm run llms`.

## Sources

### React Bits — https://reactbits.dev
134 free MIT components across text animations, backgrounds, animations and interactive components, with TypeScript/JavaScript and Tailwind/CSS variants per component. Pro tier adds blocks and templates.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @react-bits/<Component>-TS-TW.
### Motion Primitives — https://motion-primitives.com
~35 minimalist motion components by ibelick, built entirely on Motion (motion.dev). Every component is a copy-paste primitive with a dedicated CLI. Pro adds 50+ premium components and sections.
License: MIT. Install: npx motion-primitives@latest add <name>.
### FancyComponents — https://fancycomponents.dev
~46 fun and weird components recreating effects from award-winning sites — letter swaps, gravity, elastic lines, gooey filters. Fully MIT and open source by danielpetho.
License: MIT. Install: pnpm dlx shadcn add @fancy/<component>.
### NumberFlow — https://number-flow.barvian.me
The animated number (odometer/digit-spin) component. Dependency-free custom element + Web Animations API, reduced-motion aware, SSR friendly. 7.7k GitHub stars.
License: MIT. Install: npm i @number-flow/react.
### Watermelon UI — https://watermelon.sh
Fully open-source shadcn-style library: components, animated micro-interactions, section blocks and 10+ complete dashboards. Free forever for personal and commercial use.
License: Free. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://registry.watermelon.sh/r/<name>.json.
### Aceternity UI — https://ui.aceternity.com
200+ production-ready components and blocks that "look expensive" — parallax heroes, beams, shaders, docks. Free tier covers ~100 components; premium adds 200+ blocks and full templates.
License: Freemium. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @aceternity/<name>.
### shadcn/ui — https://ui.shadcn.com
65 Radix-based primitives — every install vendors the source into your project — plus 12 OIDC configuration entries from the official @oidc registry (policy form, settings page, 8 provider forms). Charts via Recharts, tables via TanStack, drawer via Vaul, carousel via Embla. The de-facto foundation most libraries below build on.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add <component>.
### Magic UI — https://magicui.design
76 animated components — animated beams, globes, marquees, device mocks, 18 text animations and 11 backgrounds. Distributed as a shadcn registry; templates are paid, all components are free.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/<component>.
### Animata — https://animata.design
154 published motion components across text, widgets, cards, bento grids, buttons and heroes — every one installable through a shadcn-style registry. The repo documents 198; 44 are still unpublished.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://animata.design/r/<section>/<name>.json.
### Animate UI — https://animate-ui.com
154 animated components in your choice of headless flavor — Radix UI, Base UI, Headless UI or native — plus 11 text animations and 14 effect primitives. All Motion-powered, installed via shadcn registry.
License: MIT + Commons Clause. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @animate-ui/<slug>.
### Launch UI — https://www.launchuicomponents.com
Free section library for marketing pages — navbar, hero, items, logos, FAQ, CTA, pricing, stats and footer blocks, plus button, badge, mockup, screenshot, glow, fade and glass utilities. React 19, Tailwind v4, Radix.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @launchui/<block>.
### Origin UI — https://coss.com/origin
The Origin UI legacy snapshot, preserved MIT inside the COSS monorepo after the rebrand: 599 variants across 31 families. Inputs alone ship 59 variants; buttons 54; selects 51.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://coss.com/origin/r/<family>.json.
### COSS UI — https://coss.com/ui
55 Base-UI-powered components, 2 hooks and 508 registry particles grouped into 54 families — the current-generation component collection from the COSS team, installed through the official @coss shadcn namespace.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @coss/<component>.
### Cult UI — https://cult-ui.com
77 MIT components — dithered and liquid-metal heroes, neumorphic and beam buttons, dynamic islands, macOS docks, 3D carousels, WebGL shaders and pixel typography. Cult Pro is a separate paid product; only the MIT repo set is cataloged.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://cult-ui.com/r/<name>.json.
### Kibo UI — https://www.kibo-ui.com
40 niche components no other library ships — Gantt charts, kanban boards, contribution graphs, credit cards, story reels, glimpse link previews, relative-time and Tinder-style decks. Fully client-side, no external services.
License: MIT. Install: npx kibo-ui add <component>.
### Streamdown — https://streamdown.ai
Vercel's streaming-Markdown renderer — the engine behind AI Elements Message/Response. 1 core component that handles incomplete, unterminated Markdown mid-stream, plus 4 official plugins for Shiki code, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams and CJK text.
License: Free. Install: npm install streamdown.
### Generative Loaders — https://generativeloaders.com
46 accessible loading states for AI interfaces from 3 primitives: 16 append-aware TextLoader reveals for streaming responses, 18 compact InlineLoader activity indicators and 12 ImageLoader image-generation placeholders. All reduced-motion aware and SSR-safe.
License: MIT. Install: npm install generative-loaders.
### UI SDK — https://ui-sdk.dev
Vercel Labs' headless UI SDK — 50+ behavior primitives (createPopup, createTypeahead, createRovingFocus, createReorder, createVirtualizer …) and 55 unstyled React components built on them, from Accordion to Color Picker, Token Input, Tree and Waterfall. Also ships Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components bindings.
License: Free. Install: npm install @ui-sdk/react @ui-sdk/core.
### wterm — https://wterm.dev
Vercel Labs' web terminal that renders rows as DOM text, so native selection, find and screen readers just work. A Zig VT parser compiled to a ~49 KB WASM core, an optional libghostty core and an opt-in WebGL renderer.
License: Free. Install: npm install @wterm/dom @wterm/react.
### Skullet — https://skullet.lochie.me
Auto-skeletons: wrap the component you'd render once data arrives and Skullet measures it and draws an exact skeleton over it, so nothing shifts on reveal. One component with React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla exports.
License: MIT. Install: npm install skullet.
### EasyUI — https://easyui.site
137 MIT components distributed through the shadcn GitHub-registry pattern — spring buttons, morphing dialogs, gliding navigation pills, hand-written SVG charts, AI chat surfaces, canvas backgrounds and wallet/payment cards. React 19 + Tailwind v4.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add Surajmaurya1/easyui/<name>.
### editorcn — https://www.rtecn.space
Tiptap-based rich text editing as shadcn registry items: a toolbar Rich Text Editor, a Notion-style Block Editor, a static renderer, 8 drop-in extensions (tables, mentions, callouts, code blocks, markdown, paste cleanup…) and 5 templates (comment box, email composer, document editor, full editors).
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://www.rtecn.space/r/<name>.json.
### loading.dev — https://loading.dev
36 lightweight spinner and loading-indicator components (Arc, Atom, Blocks … Wave) shipped as one npm package. Every indicator takes size, color and duration props, exposes playState and respects reduced motion — pure CSS/SVG, no Tailwind needed.
License: MIT. Install: npm install loading-dev.
### Its Hover — https://itshover.com
263 hover-triggered animated icon components built with Motion, each installable as its own shadcn registry item. Sponsor-funded, no paid tier.
License: Free. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://itshover.com/r/<icon-name>.json.
### Amicro — https://amicro.vercel.app
174 micro-interaction registry items — 135 loaders, entrance/scroll/hover/cursor transitions, text reveals, magnetic and glow buttons, 3D card carousels, dither charts, AI prompt surfaces and 5 motion hooks.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subhan-code/Amicro--Micro-transitions-/main/registry/ui/<name>.json.
### Kokonut UI — https://kokonutui.com
116 free MIT components — 27 AI chat/agent pieces (tool approvals, tool calls, diff review, inline citations, voice, checkout) plus inputs, cards, buttons, backgrounds, navigation and text effects. Kokonut UI Pro (heroes, sections, templates) is paid and excluded.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/<name>.
### Arc UI — https://uiarc.dev
121 free components + 22 free blocks — inputs, data-viz charts, disclosure, feedback, and auth/marketing blocks. Styled with CSS modules and CSS variables (not Tailwind classes), Motion presets and reduced-motion support throughout.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @uiarc/<name>.
### snapcn — https://snapcn.dev
62 free MIT components for programmatic video — kinetic titles, captions, logo stings, device frames, cursor clicks, AI-chat input scenes and launch scenes, all rendered with Remotion.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @snapcn/<name>.
### beUI — https://beui.dev
122 free component pages — 59 Motion components, 24 blocks, 18 AI-agent pieces, 17 animated charts and 4 casino games. React 19, Tailwind v4, Motion 12.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @beui/<name>.
### Bklit UI — https://bklit.com
20 chart types — line, area, bar, candlestick, choropleth, composed, funnel, gauge, heatmap, pie, radar, radial, ring, sankey, scatter, sparkline, sunburst — plus 15 chart utilities (legend, tooltip, brush, trend line, deadline …) and 3 stat-card blocks, installed through the @bklit shadcn registry. Tailwind v4.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @bklit/<chart-name>.
### pdfcn — https://pdfcn.dev
24 PDF primitives (text, heading, data table, graph, QR code, signature, watermark, page header/footer …) and 20 document templates (invoices, reports, tickets, shipping labels, work orders) — every item ships for both the Takumi and Forme renderers.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @pdfcn/takumi/<name>.
### Remocn — https://remocn.dev
925 Remotion components: 256 text animations, 124 number animations, 66 product scenes, 59 transitions, 59 shaders, 45 logo stings, 75 UI primitives and flows, 31 caption styles, 100 animated icons and full video templates — installed through the @remocn shadcn registry.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @remocn/<name>.
### assistant-ui — https://www.assistant-ui.com
147 AI-chat components — threads, composers, message parts, tool UIs, reasoning, attachments, model pickers, voice — in two tiers: 36 runtime-bound components and 111 props-driven elements. The de-facto standard chat-UI library (Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph and more).
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://r.assistant-ui.com/<name>.

The dot size also enlarges slightly, enhancing the focus on the current event. The component offers a sleek and smooth animation experience, perfect for showcasing chronological steps, milestones, or achievements in an engaging and user-friendly manner.This component is highly customizable, allowing easy modifications to the timeline content and styling, making it suitable for diverse applications such as resumes, project timelines, or product roadmaps. ### Chat & AI (chat)
- **Attachment** https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/attachment — Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]

- **Streamdown** https://streamdown.ai/docs — Drop-in react-markdown replacement built for streaming AI output — parses incomplete/unterminated Markdown gracefully (via remend), GFM tables and task lists, hardened rendering, memoized updates. Powers AI Elements Message/Response. Add `@source "../node_modules/streamdown/dist/*.js"` to your Tailwind CSS. [Free, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **Code Plugin** https://streamdown.ai/docs/plugins/code — @streamdown/code — Shiki syntax highlighting for fenced code blocks inside streamed Markdown, with copy/download controls. Needs its own Tailwind `@source` line. [Free, live-previewable, category: chat]

- **Mermaid Plugin** https://streamdown.ai/docs/plugins/mermaid — @streamdown/mermaid — renders ```mermaid code blocks as diagrams (flowcharts, sequence diagrams) in streamed Markdown. [Free, live-previewable, category: chat]
